summary: Glenn County, CA site: the FFLA index lists an enclosed tower as gone and OpenStreetMap maps a fire lookout building; no history or current description was found.

facts.design: enclosed tower (Forest Fire Lookout Association index)
facts.status_note: FFLA index lists it as gone; OpenStreetMap maps a fire lookout building with no condition tag; no source describes what remains

evidence.supports: Forest Lookouts Glenn County list includes Red Mountain by name

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The brief notes an OpenStreetMap reading of standing. The OSM node has building and fire_lookout tags and no condition tag, so it does not show a standing tower. We follow the FFLA index (gone) at low confidence.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Forest Lookouts Red Mountain entry for Glenn County is a heading with no body text, the FFLA index gives only a type and status, and the OSM node has tags only (no history, no date). The story is below the 120-word floor because the sources do not support more; expand it once a dated source turns up (NHLR, a newspaper, or Forest Service records). Two web searches found nothing on this site. CAL FIRE's Lookouts list places a Red Mountain Lookout in its Humboldt-Del Norte column, not Glenn County, so it should not be used for this record.
